title: 贵人是锦上添花，不是雪中送炭

source.kind: 历史会话 Bash 调用 local_typeset.py（CLI 参数原样）

text.title: 贵人是锦上添花|不是雪中送炭
text.body: 人终究只能靠自己，所谓的贵人，大多数都锦上添花，|而不是雪中送炭，自己强了，别人才愿意帮你，|人和人之间本质上都是价值交换。
text.en: In the end you can only rely on yourself. Most so-called benefactors add flowers to brocade rather than send charcoal in snowy weather. When you are strong, others are willing to help you - between people, it is essentially an exchange of value.
text.credit: 原作 歌川广重《日本橋雪晴》1856年 · 名所江戸百景 · 雪晴蓝白
